title: Rapid point-of-care method for identifying Group B Streptococcus
core_idea: Develop a POCT that uses chromogenic culture media whose pigment concentration is measured by specific absorption spectroscopy, converting light absorption into an electrical signal and then into a defined variable that quantitatively relates to GBS concentration to determine colonization status.
tldr: Proposes a POCT approach that translates chromogenic media pigment signals via absorption spectroscopy into electrical and computed values to quantitatively identify GBS colonization in pregnant women for screening and prophylaxis decisions.
